status: Working local LibreChat fork with Canvas, document reading, public research tools and a limited browser. The next study focuses on academic activities, visible assistance guidance, student control and inspectable evidence. School deployment remains pending.
scope_change: Retain the limited LibreChat fork as a candidate for WebbGPT's next version. Prioritize complete academic activities and evaluation with Webb students/faculty before expanding integrations. Selected Microsoft files are conditional on activity needs; mailbox access and the earlier independent agent-workspace concept are deferred.
current_scope: Use LibreChat's native chat, agents, tools, attachments, exports and institutional administration.
Study assignment help, reading/revision and bounded data/research activities with Webb students and faculty.
Complete the existing Canvas assignment/rubric experience with visible teacher assistance guidance and convenient hint, practice and critique choices.
Keep capable ordinary chat and evaluate a small institution-approved model choice with clear selection and budget explanations.
Make actual sources, incomplete retrieval, tool actions, calculations, outputs and cancellation easy to inspect.
Plan a short, editable AI-use disclosure for student work and faculty preparation, grounded in visible assistance rather than authorship claims.
Advance isolated Python execution through one academic task; validate hosting, file delivery and lifecycle boundaries before student use.
Evaluate against existing WebbGPT and participants' usual tools before adding selected OneDrive/SharePoint file access.
retained_boundaries: Do not replace Canvas, email, messaging, or authoritative document storage.
Keep prose portable in Markdown; do not build a live Word editor.
Connected sources remain within the person’s existing access.
School hosting is distinct from the approved model provider’s data handling.
deferred: Outlook/mailbox access and additional GitHub/Slack connectors.
Authenticated browser sessions, extensions, student-machine execution and general student terminal access.
Shared task-folder provisioning, native folder permission management and parallel-agent orchestration.
Custom artifact collaboration, working-copy integration, merging and real-time document editing.
LTI launch, course roster sync, per-course budgets and multi-school hosting until independently justified.

archive.contains: Earlier pitch, complete interactive mockup, design log, Markdown example bundle, and final screenshots.

reuse_plan.upstream: Chat and AI runtime; school SSO; groups and permissions; approved model/tool configuration; account balances; shared agents; file uploads and Microsoft 365 file selection.
reuse_plan.evaluate: Approved model quality/cost; deployment isolation and lifecycle behavior; the existing admin panel's deployment readiness. Earlier connector and institutional precedents remain dated research in references.json.
reuse_plan.custom: Existing Canvas/document integrations and school configuration; next, assistance-guidance presentation, activity-specific help choices, evidence/control usability and reviewed AI-use disclosure.
reuse_plan.avoid: A new harness, LMS, shared filesystem, or editor. No current scope is selected merely because a plugin or upstream feature exists.

implemented: Approved helper/model selection and help styles.
Canvas course/material picker and sample source inspection.
Local sample CSV calculation and chart.
Educator helper publishing to a sample group.
Institution profile, people access toggles, and account allowance views.
not_implemented: Actual LibreChat fork, login, live model inference, or tool execution.
Canvas / Microsoft account authorization or API calls.
General-purpose source grounding, document parsing, live sharing, security enforcement, or retention services.
prototype.storage: New browser-local key fieldwork-librechat-pilot-v1. Earlier prototype state is kept separate.
prototype.scope: This section describes the historical HTML simulation only. Current application capabilities are recorded in ../docs/school.md.

privacy_and_authorization: Use explicit per-user connections, on-demand admitted sources, disclosed content access/retention and approved model-provider processing. Keep personal memory off by default in the intended study profile. Shared helpers never confer the author's credentials. Deployment controls and data handling must be verified before student use.
prompt_guidance: Help styles and teacher instructions guide assistance; missing guidance remains unknown. Platform and connector controls enforce actual authorization. Help instructions cannot certify academic integrity or constrain other AI apps.
provenance: The October HTML/CSS/JavaScript, branding and sample data were original for the concept. Its historical validation below applies to that simulation. The live fork reuses LibreChat and separately recorded components; runtime status, attribution and verification are documented under ../docs/.

checks: Parsed both active JSON records and checked inline JavaScript syntax with node --check.
Verified desktop pitch, chat, school management, research, and 390 x 844 mobile layouts; no horizontal overflow in mobile chat or management.
Verified Canvas material selection and preservation of earlier source citations after changing course context.
Verified sample-data analysis and a newly uploaded two-row synthetic CSV (means 3.00 and 6.00; paired difference 3.00).
Verified educator helper publication and visibility within the sample student group.
Verified disabling data analysis and pausing a sample account affect the student controls.
Verified separate student, educator, and administrator views; administrator navigation does not list personal chats.
No browser console warnings or errors were recorded during final QA.
Checked local HTML links and preserved archive/example files.
validation.limit: Historical HTML simulation checks only. Current runtime verification and deployment limits are recorded in ../docs/school.md and ../docs/browser-audit.md.

priority_order: Agree academic study activities and assistance guidance with faculty and students.
Complete one Canvas assignment help experience using existing source and chat paths.
Improve evidence inspection, control and reviewed AI-use disclosure.
Evaluate a small approved model choice on those activities.
Validate isolated Python for one data/research task.
Evaluate the full experience before expanding connectors or pursuing replacement.
excluded: Automated grading, academic misconduct detection or decisions, and student surveillance analytics.

scope_history.decision: Limit the product to a LibreChat fork; preserve the independent agent workspace in the archive.
Use Webb context and freshman reflections to prioritize academic activities, assistance clarity, student control, evidence and a comparative study. Defer mailbox expansion.
